name: twitch
label: Twitch
description: Twitch is the world's leading live streaming platform for gamers and the things we love!

oauth2.scope: channel:manage:broadcast user:write:chat moderator:manage:announcements clips:edit user:read:follows moderator:read:followers moderator:read:chatters moderator:manage:banned_users channel:manage:moderators channel:read:vips moderator:read:chat_settings moderator:manage:chat_settings moderator:manage:shield_mode moderator:manage:chat_messages moderator:manage:warnings channel:read:polls channel:read:predictions channel:manage:schedule moderator:manage:shoutouts channel:read:subscriptions user:read:subscriptions channel:edit:commercial channel:read:ads

get_channel_info.label: Get Channel Info
get_channel_info.description: Get the title, category, language and tags of one or more channels. Leave empty for your own channel.

broadcaster_ids.label: Broadcaster IDs
broadcaster_ids.description: Numeric Twitch user IDs. Leave empty for your own channel.

send_chat_message.label: Send Chat Message
send_chat_message.description: Send a message to a channel's chat as your account. Requires the user:write:chat scope.

broadcaster_id.label: Broadcaster ID
broadcaster_id.description: Numeric ID of the channel to post in. Leave empty for your own channel.

send_announcement.label: Send Announcement
send_announcement.description: Send a highlighted announcement to a channel's chat where you are broadcaster or moderator. Requires the moderator:manage:announcements scope.

broadcaster_id.label: Broadcaster ID
broadcaster_id.description: Numeric ID of the channel. Leave empty for your own channel.

create_stream_marker.label: Create Stream Marker
create_stream_marker.description: Add a marker at the current position of a live stream.

broadcaster_id.description: Numeric Twitch user ID of the channel. Leave empty for your own channel.

broadcaster_id.description: Numeric Twitch user ID of the channel. Leave empty for your own channel.

user_id.label: User ID
user_id.description: Numeric Twitch ID of the user. Use Get Users to find it.
